Do you build in Hornsby and the Upper North Shore?
Yes. Our office is at 43A Florence Street, Hornsby, and we build throughout Hornsby, the Upper North Shore and the Northern Suburbs.
Can I build a duplex on my block in Hornsby?
It depends on your zoning, lot size and frontage under Hornsby Shire Council's planning controls and the NSW housing codes. We check your block for free and explain your options.
Do you handle approvals with Hornsby Shire Council?
Yes. We manage your approval from start to finish, whether that is a complying development certificate (CDC) through a private certifier or a development application (DA) with council.
How much does it cost to build a home in Hornsby?
It depends on size, storeys, finishes and your site. Use our estimator for a quick guide, then book a free consultation for a fixed-price quote.
